subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Apple of discord
solution:
The correct answer is: **Matter of dispute**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Apple of discord"** means a subject or issue over which people disagree and argue; a matter of dispute. (विवाद का कारण)

 
 
• **Example: **The inheritance issue became an **apple of discord** among the siblings.
 
 
 
• **"Matter of dispute"** refers to a topic or issue that causes disagreement or argument. (विवाद का विषय)
 
 
• **Example: **The boundary line between the two properties has been a **matter of dispute** for years.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Solution of dispute** (विवाद का समाधान): The act of resolving a disagreement or argument.

 
 
• **Example:** The mediator proposed a **solution of dispute** that was acceptable to both parties.
 
 
 
• **Cause of happiness** (खुशी का कारण): Something that brings joy or contentment.
 
 
• **Example: **The birth of their child was a great **cause of happiness** for the family.
 
 
 
• **Disruption of communication** (संचार में बाधा): An interruption or breakdown in the exchange of information.
 
 
• **Example:** The storm caused a **disruption of communication** in the remote areas.
